title: [agent] Missing scope acknowledgment
body:
### Pre-flight checklist

- [x] This task has been discussed and approved by a maintainer (Discord or otherwise)
- [x] I understand this task will be implemented by an AI agent (Codex) and reviewed by an AI agent (Claude Code)
- [x] I understand a human maintainer must approve the plan before implementation begins

### Goal

Update a documentation link.

### Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The link points to the current document

### Risk Level

risk:low — documentation, config, or cosmetic only
